result.rationale: In `refreshOAuthTokens`, sharing mode returns a raw `fetch` Response object (no `.data`). The Zoho CRM CalendarService diff replaces an axios call (which returns `{data: ...}`) with `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then immediately reads `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` on the very next line — a Response has no `.data`, so accessing `.error` on `undefined` throws a TypeError whenever credential sharing is enabled.

judged_text: In sharing mode zohoCrmTokenInfo is a fetch Response with no .data property, so zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error throws TypeError. Every Zoho CRM calendar operation with sharing enabled crashes at "if (!zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error)" instead of refreshing the token.

record.issue_text: [BUG] In sharing mode zohoCrmTokenInfo is a fetch Response with no .data property, so zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error throws TypeError. Every Zoho CRM calendar operation with sharing enabled crashes at "if (!zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error)" instead of refreshing the token.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` it returns a `fetch(...)` Response object. In `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `zohoCrmTokenInfo` is assigned from `await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then immediately accessed as `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error`. If sharing mode is enabled and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` is set, `zohoCrmTokenInfo` will be a fetch `Response` (no `.data`), causing a runtime `TypeError` at `if (!zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error)`.
